# `scene.tag`: Tag

Adds or removes tags such as high, low, collision or lod1 on an object.

- Category: scene
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(tags x (added + removed))
- Flags: undoable
- Also known as: label, mark

Tags drive pipelines: bake pairs (`high` and `low`), collision proxies (`collision`), LOD meshes (`lod1`...).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `add` | `string[]` | `[]` | Tags to add, for example `high`, `low`, `collision`, `lod1`. |
| `remove` | `string[]` | `[]` | Tags to remove. |
| `target` | `string` | required | Object (name, path or id). |

## Examples

```json
{"add":["low"],"target":"crate"}
```

Result: `crate (o:1) tags: low`
